label: sec:scheme-notation
title: Notation: group schemes and projective spaces over $R$
html:
Notation: group schemes and projective spaces over R.

Every construction in this paper is formulated once over an arbitrary commutative ring R and specialises to any base — a reader working over \mathbb{Z}_p, \mathbb{F}_q, or \mathbb{C} reads the same axioms and the same proofs, only the ground ring changes. To keep that substitution visible, all algebraic groups and projective spaces are written with their base ring R explicit:

Object Notation Over \mathbb{C}
Special unitary group \mathrm{SU}_2(R) \mathrm{SU}(2)
Maximal torus / Reeb gauge group U_1(R) U(1)
Quantum group \mathrm{SU}_{q,2}(R) \mathrm{SU}_q(2)
Projective line \mathbb{P}^1(R) \mathbb{CP}^1 \cong S^2
Multiplicative group \mathbb{G}_m(R) = R^{\times} \mathbb{C}^{\times}

When the base ring is clear from context, we may write \mathrm{SU}_2 for \mathrm{SU}_2(R) and \mathbb{P}^1 for \mathbb{P}^1(R). The category-theoretic definitions (quantum universe, quantum observable universe) are stated at this level of generality.
